reason: Approved MemoryManager allocation backend after explicit manager accounting; CEIC-021 evidence only and not transaction, visibility, security, recovery, parser, reference, WAL, benchmark, optimizer-plan, index-finality, or agent-action authority.

Approved single internal ReleaseAlignedAllocationStorage backend. Existing allocator callers retain active-owner validation or exact pending-allocation ownership, protected-memory cleanup, and their accounting and reservation release ordering. The one-site exception does not authorize raw deallocation in consumers.
Approved TypedArena placement construction into already reserved arena storage; no raw hot-path allocation authority is introduced.
Approved TypedArena placement construction for reserved array storage; construction does not allocate outside the arena.
Approved TypedArena metadata placement construction inside reserved arena storage for deterministic cleanup.
Approved TypedArena object placement construction inside a reserved slot; no direct heap allocation is performed.
Approved typed slab placement construction into reservation-backed slab storage; no raw allocator use occurs on the hot path.

Approved reservation-backed memory API handle construction after CEIC-011 ledger reservation, commit and retained-ledger-lease admission. The handle owns rollback while physical capacity is acquired before publication. This exact factory exception does not approve payload allocation outside the governed resource.
Approved SizeClassAllocator factory construction inside the typed slab subsystem after reservation-backed policy setup.
Approved cache factory construction for the CEIC-014 thread-local per-core cache API; hot hits do not depend on raw allocation.

Approved provisional RAII foreign-memory handle after ledger admission. Its manager remains null until all fallible evidence and map publication succeed, preventing cleanup from releasing an unpublished owner. No provider payload allocation is authorized by this one-site exception.

Approved fixed private capacity-lease control constructed before allocator accounting publication. Token zero is inert during failure unwinding; actual capacity remains subject to allocator limits and binary ownership admission.

Approved fixed private governor control after binary owner and finite policy validation. This is not permission for KDF workspace allocation; per-call memory and work remain subject to the hierarchical ledger and retained grant.

Approved fixed private statement receipt control, after active governor and exact binary owner checks. Issuance reuses an existing live statement receipt and prunes expired controls. KDF payload memory still requires Acquire and retained ledger admission.

Placement construction only, inside object_limit slots already allocated by ReservationBackedMemoryResource with overflow-checked byte count and binary owner admission. This does not allocate a second heap payload.

Placement construction only, inside reader_limit slots already allocated by ReservationBackedMemoryResource with overflow-checked byte count and binary owner admission. This does not allocate a second heap payload.

Safe-retirement placement construction after BeginCreate acquires exact sizeof(T) aligned storage from the governed resource. Failed construction retains retirement and release responsibility. No general direct heap allocation is approved.

Approved private receipt factory after current MGA authority, descriptor, DAG ordering and bounded workspace admission. This exception covers only the fixed receipt allocation, not arbitrary payload growth or additional factories.

Approved private identity-owner control after canonical binary key validation, duplicate rejection, a 64-key limit and maximum binding-byte admission. This one-site factory exception does not exempt other allocations or growth from the source gate.

Approved private identity-owner control after canonical binary key validation, duplicate rejection and explicit maximum key-count and binding-byte admission. This one-site factory exception does not exempt other allocations or growth from the source gate.

Approved fixed private storage-ownership control allocated before native handle transfer. Allocation failure leaves handles with the existing owner; lease publication still requires checked durable descriptor publication. No page buffer or query allocation is authorized.
Approved process-wide default MemoryManager installation mutex; it protects configuration only and is not an allocator hot-path dependency.
